summary: Find sprites connected to grey path endpoints, match source sprites by border color to destination center color, transfer source center color to destination center, then delete unconnected sprites.
src: colored bordered sprites s (sprites with center color and border color)
dst: colored bordered sprites d connected to grey path endpoints (path endpoint must connect to sprite's center position)
multi_step: Step 1: identify grey connected path and sprites at path endpoints (d); Step 2: for each d, find s where s.border_color == d.center_color; Step 3: copy s.center_color to d.center; Step 4: delete all sprites not connected to grey path
src2: all sprites not connected to grey path
